title: Refund expires at midnight
scenario: An email says a tax refund adjustment is waiting but must be claimed before midnight. The page asks you to confirm bank details and a government ID number.

answers.A: Enter the bank details now but leave the ID field blank until the refund status updates.
answers.B: Ignore the link and check your tax account or tax authority through its official site and normal communication process.
answers.C: Ask your tax preparer or accountant whether such a refund process is legitimate.

explanation: Refund urgency is designed to turn good news into rushed disclosure. Tax authorities have established channels for account changes.
proTip: Unexpected money deserves the same skepticism as unexpected debt.
